title: Co-AttenDWG: Co-Attentive Dimension-Wise Gating and Expert Fusion for Multi-Modal Offensive Content Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's multi-label classification accuracy and macro F1-score in detecting misogynistic and objectifying content in multilingual, code-mixed multimodal memes using the MIMIC (Misogyny Identification in Multimodal Internet Content) dataset.
Measuring the model's performance (accuracy and F1-score) in identifying general prejudiced and humiliating content within multimodal social media posts using the MIMIC dataset.
